senses.sense_definition: Zorgverlener in een huisartsenpraktijk die patiënten met chronische aandoeningen begeleidt en behandelt volgens vaste protocollen.

examples.text: De <w>praktijkondersteuner</w> helpt patiënten met diabetes om hun bloedsuikerspiegel beter onder controle te houden.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>practice nurse</w> helps patients with diabetes to keep their blood sugar levels under better control.

examples.text: Na het consult bij de huisarts besprak de <w>praktijkondersteuner</w> het behandelplan voor de hoge bloeddruk.

target_lang_translations.en: After the consultation with the GP, the <w>practice nurse</w> discussed the treatment plan for the high blood pressure.

target_lang_definitions.en: A healthcare professional in a general practice who supports and treats patients with chronic conditions according to established protocols.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The most common equivalent in the UK/Commonwealth healthcare systems for a nurse working in a GP practice.
A broader term used in some regions for a professional who performs clinical tasks under the supervision of a doctor.
A literal translation often used to describe the supportive role in a primary care setting.
